name: ClinicalTrials.gov
summary: The US National Library of Medicine's registry of clinical studies worldwide: search studies by condition, intervention, sponsor, location or status, and fetch one study's full record.
notes: Search terms use ClinicalTrials.gov's Essie expression syntax (AND, OR, NOT, AREA[Field]value, quotes for phrases).

Paging is by token: a response with nextPageToken has more; pass it as pageToken and repeat every other parameter unchanged (only countTotal, pageSize and pageToken may change). A page can come back with an empty studies list.
A full study record is large: pass fields (comma- or pipe-separated piece names such as NCTId,BriefTitle,OverallStatus) to keep responses small. /studies/metadata lists the field names.

endpoints.name: Search clinical studies
endpoints.summary: Studies matching query and filter parameters, one page at a time, as JSON or CSV.

query_cond.description: Condition or disease, in Essie syntax.

query_term.description: Other terms, searched across the record.

query_id.description: Study IDs (NCT number, org study ID, secondary IDs).

filter_overallStatus.description: Comma- or pipe-separated statuses, e.g. RECRUITING,NOT_YET_RECRUITING,COMPLETED.

filter_ids.description: Comma- or pipe-separated NCT IDs (aliases match too).

filter_advanced.description: Extra filter in Essie syntax, e.g. AREA[Phase]PHASE3; does not affect ranking.

fields.description: Comma- or pipe-separated fields to return; all when omitted.

sort.description: Up to two sort keys, field[:asc|desc], e.g. LastUpdatePostDate:desc or @relevance. Only date and numeric fields sort; unsorted by default.

countTotal.description: true returns totalCount with the first page.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous page; omit for the first page.

format.description: json (default) or csv; for csv the next page token is in the x-next-page-token header.

markupFormat.description: How markup text fields are formatted in JSON; default markdown.

notes: With no query or filter every study matches. If a query.* value holds only NCT IDs, the filters are ignored.
filter.* parameters do not change ranking; query.* parameters do when sorted by @relevance.

endpoints.name: Get one study by NCT number
endpoints.summary: The full record of one study: design, arms, eligibility, locations, contacts, outcomes and results when posted.

fields.description: Comma- or pipe-separated fields to return; all when omitted.

markupFormat.description: How markup text fields are formatted in JSON; default markdown.

notes: An old NCT number kept as an alias answers with a 301 redirect to the current study.

endpoints.name: List the study data model's fields
endpoints.summary: Every field of a study record with its type, for the fields and sort parameters.

includeHistoricOnly.description: Include fields found only in historic data.

endpoints.name: List enumeration values
endpoints.summary: Each enum type (status, phase, study type...) with the fields that use it and its allowed values.

endpoints.name: Count the values of study fields
endpoints.summary: Value statistics for leaf fields across all studies, e.g. how many studies have each overall status or phase.

fields.description: Comma- or pipe-separated piece names or field paths, e.g. OverallStatus,Phase.

types.description: Comma- or pipe-separated field types to filter by.
